description.summary: The bill raises the child and dependent care tax credit to a 50% maximum and 35% minimum, indexes credit amounts for inflation, and makes the credit refundable. It also increases the employer exclusion for dependent care benefits to $7,500 (from $5,000) and indexes it for inflation, applying to taxpayers with qualified child and dependent care expenses and employer-sponsored benefits.

impact.summary: The PACE Act would make the federal child and dependent care tax credit refundable, raise the credit rate to 50% (minimum 35%), and index credit limits for inflation. It would raise the employer‑provided dependent care exclusion (including dependent care FSAs) to $7,500 from $5,000 and affect individual taxpayers claiming the credit, employers offering dependent‑care benefits, and the IRS.
